n1.text:
Overview fixes
• One 'Finish setting up' banner with progress + Continue setup (replaces checklist + duplicate KPI)
• 'Ready to sell' says WHY a store isn't ready
• Store row shows readiness + Open store
• Activity written as sentences
• Compact sidebar: 36px rows, deep green, bright green kept for actions
• Org name lives only in sidebar; language + theme moved to account menu
• Title 28px, one-line description

n2.text:
Stores fixes
• New Readiness column (no more 'Active' vs 'Needs setup' contradiction)
• Explicit Open store action + row chevron
• Manager shown with initials
• Search/Columns toolbar hidden under 8 rows
• Plan slots shown in footer
• No redundant breadcrumb on top-level pages

n3.text:
Stock movement fixes
• Transfers + Distributions merged into one page with two tabs and clear names
• Disabled action now explains itself
• Empty state shows requirements with what you have
• Offers the next useful action instead of a dead end

n4.text:
Team fixes
• 'Organisation-wide' is neutral, not amber warning
• Roles as chips, avatar + email in one cell
• Row actions menu
• Nudge to invite the first cashier

n5.text:
Products fixes
• Empty state with primary + import actions (no empty column headers)
• 'Catalogue setup' button removed (already in sidebar)
• Optional setup links shown in context
• Naming matches nav: Products everywhere

n6.text:
Catalogue setup fixes
• One balanced list instead of lopsided 2 columns
• Each row shows its status
• 'Product setup rules' renamed 'Product types'
• Recommended order numbered

n7.text:
Settings fixes
• Horizontal section tabs free up width
• GST as option cards with explanation inside; GSTIN only when Registered
• Styled selects instead of OS dropdowns
• Sticky save bar appears only with unsaved changes

n8.text:
Sign-in fixes
• Same tokens, radius and font as the app
• Crisp product preview instead of washed-out photo
• Headline tracking relaxed
• Language as a compact select

n9.text:
Create organisation fixes
• URL field shows deltcrm.app/ prefix and fills from the name
• Show/hide password
• Live length check instead of a static hint
• Sections clearly numbered

n10.text:
POS fixes
• Customer, discount and coupon moved into the cart (out of the pay dialog)
• Quantity is typeable, not only +/-
• Shortcut hints always visible
• Clear register/shift status in header

n11.text:
Take payment fixes
• Only what is needed to get paid: amount, method, cash received
• Quick-cash buttons (Exact, 100, 200, 500, 2000)
• Change to return shown large
• Split payment is a link, not always-on fields
